connector.name: Printscale MCP
connector.registryDescription: Upscale images to print-ready files (TIFF/PNG/JPG) via PrintScale.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package printscale-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the amortegui84 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PRINTSCALE_API_KEY
env.description: PrintScale API key (create one at https://printscale.app/dashboard/api)
